results.title: France – Printing and related services – TRAVAUX D'IMPRESSION ET DE REPROGRAPHIE
unknowns: No numeric turnover floor was found in the recovered RC, but SPM alone does not evidence the requested recent printing references, equipment or Imprim'Vert-equivalent status

With a certified printer/group member this becomes credible, but supplier economics and sample execution remain material.
